name: afyalink
description: AfyaLink: An Offline-First Community Health Reporting System for Rural Kenya. From Community Reports to Faster Health Action.

scripts.postinstall: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c blue,green "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c blue,green "npm --prefix frontend run start" "npm --prefix backend run start:prod"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:backend:e2e
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:frontend && npm run typecheck:backend
